description: This file defines the CosmosGatewayListProvider class, which implements IGatewayListProvider to fetch gateway URIs from Azure Cosmos DB for Orleans clustering. It includes methods for initialization and retrieving gateway endpoints, along with internal logging.

classes.name: CosmosGatewayListProvider
classes.description: Implements IGatewayListProvider to provide gateway URIs from Cosmos DB for Orleans clustering.

methods.name: CosmosGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing the provider with dependencies and configuration options.

methods.name: InitializeGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes the Cosmos DB container for gateway lookup.

methods.name: GetGateways
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of gateway URIs from Cosmos DB.

methods.name: ConvertToGatewayUri
methods.description: Converts a SiloEntity to a gateway URI.

methods.name: LogErrorInitializingGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Logs errors during initialization of the Cosmos DB gateway list provider.

methods.name: LogErrorReadingGatewayListFromCosmosDb
methods.description: Logs errors encountered when reading the gateway list from Cosmos DB.
